style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;spacingRight=10;fillColor=#fffde7;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" value="<b>Cross-cutting</b>
fail-open: a model error, abstain, or fallback verdict never skips a session (only confident non-fallback "trivial" gate skips do).
L1 determinism: capture, triage, batching, parsing, deletion and the turn-count watermark are all deterministic code; the model only ever acts inside the rag-brain drain child and the optional gate.

div.div:
Cross-cutting
fail-open: a model error, abstain, or fallback verdict never skips a session (only confident non-fallback "trivial" gate skips do).
L1 determinism: capture, triage, batching, parsing, deletion and the turn-count watermark are all deterministic code; the model only ever acts inside the rag-brain drain child and the optional gate.
deterministic triage runs before the cooldown gate (it is free); the gate runs only after the cooldown gate (model consulted only when a drain is about to happen).
